title: DiiHAUZZ Chef Knife, 7 Inch Ultra Sharp Japanese Santoku Knife, High Carbon Steel Forged Professional Kitchen Knife with Full Tang Triple-Riveted Ergonomic Handle for Slicing, Chopping, Dicing
reviews: This knife is clearly professional chef quality but unfortunately I needed to return it because I had ordered a "new" knife but the delivery department made an error and sent me a used one. This was not the fault of the seller but the clearing house department I am sure. The knife itself looks streamlined and graceful, is well made and all stainless steel, made to last almost a lifetime with its beautifully spaced sharp serrated edge and thin blade, designed to slice your bread into any thickness and thinness you would desire. It seemed to me a bit heavy because I am a small person but to someone else the weight might be perfect. This knife is elegantly packaged in its own custom lined black box. This knife, if new, would make a lovely gift to anyone looking for a dazzlingly enviable keepsake. I would have kept it if the clearing house had not made the mistake on the order.
Very nice onife just wish I could have gotten one @ 7” instead of 10” overall nice product.
The knife was very sharp when I first received it. It became dull quickly.
This knife is very sharp and very comfortable to hold.
Very good bread knife. It’s a good length a little heavy but also very sturdy. Would recommend.
Be careful. This knife is sharp and will cut anything.
The sharpest easiest knife ever! Nice heavy handle for balance. I love this knife!
